content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IISER Pune Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Counsellor (Full-Time) and 2 for Counsellor (Part-Time).

content_sections.text: Counsellor (Full-Time) & Counsellor (Part-Time): Masters' Degree in Clinical Psychology with 55% marks and 5 years experience.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Counsellor posts at IISER Pune is scheduled for 16th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue by 09:00 AM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters' Degree in Clinical Psychology with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, 5 years of relevant experience is required for both full-time and part-time positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Counsellor position at IISER Pune?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Counsellor post at IISER Pune. This includes 2 positions for Full-Time Counsellor and 2 positions for Part-Time Counsellor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Counsellor posts is 40 years. Age relaxation may be provided for candidates with higher qualifications or significant experience, subject to prior approval.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Full-Time Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The Full-Time Counsellor position offers a starting salary of Rs. 88,650/- per month. For Part-Time Counsellors, the salary will be proportionate to the time commitment and job responsibilities.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this IISER Pune Counsellor recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Counsellor posts at IISER Pune primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune), located in Pune, Maharashtra, with pincode 411008. The exact address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the specified venue on the interview date with all required documents. No online application form is mentioned.
